decision.explanation: Documents d00, d02, and d03 explicitly state Anna Palaiologina (daughter of Andronikos Angelos Palaiologos) was first married to John II Orsini and later to John Komnenos Asen; document d04 contains a contradictory claim regarding Thomas Preljubović that conflicts with the detailed biographical accounts in other texts, and documents d05-d08 refer to different individuals (Anna of Moscow or Anna of Savoy).
